style: Style: classic MU Online (Webzen) fantasy MMORPG interface - dark burnished bronze and antique gold filigree metal, deep red gemstones, gothic angular shapes, rich painterly game-UI rendering, crisp clean edges, orthographic flat front view, no text, no letters, no watermark.

card.prompt: A single wide horizontal CHARACTER SLOT CARD panel for a character selection list: a dark smoky stone/leather plate with a thin bronze-gold beveled rim and small angular corner caps; on the LEFT end an empty round recessed socket ring (bronze, dark inside) where a class emblem will be placed; the rest of the plate is plain, flat and dark so text can be drawn on it. Unlit, calm, not glowing. Aspect ratio about 4:1, filling the canvas width.

card_selected.prompt: A single wide horizontal CHARACTER SLOT CARD panel for a character selection list in its SELECTED state: a dark warm-bronze plate with a bright glowing gold beveled rim, a soft golden inner glow along the edges and small angular corner caps with tiny glowing red gems; on the LEFT end an empty round recessed socket ring (gold, dark inside) where a class emblem will be placed; the rest of the plate is plain and dark enough for text. Aspect ratio about 4:1, filling the canvas width.

button_primary.prompt: A single wide horizontal MAIN ACTION BUTTON plate (for the most important action on screen): a long deep crimson-red enamel panel framed by an ornate bronze-gold beveled rim, pointed angular end caps on left and right each with a red gem and small spread metal wing ornaments, a small gold ornament at top and bottom center. Flat, even center so a label can be drawn on it. Perfectly symmetric. Very wide aspect ratio about 5:1, filling the canvas width.

button_primary_hover.prompt: A single wide horizontal MAIN ACTION BUTTON plate in its HIGHLIGHTED/hover state: a long bright glowing crimson-red enamel panel with warm inner light, framed by a brightly glowing gold beveled rim, pointed angular end caps on left and right each with a glowing red gem and small spread metal wing ornaments, a small gold ornament at top and bottom center. Flat, even center so a label can be drawn on it. Perfectly symmetric. Very wide aspect ratio about 5:1, filling the canvas width.

icons_classes_1.prompt: A row of exactly 4 separate square character CLASS EMBLEM icons, evenly spaced in a single horizontal row with clear empty gaps between them, each icon same size inside its own round bronze-gold medallion frame with dark interior: 1) a glowing blue arcane orb with lightning (dark wizard), 2) a broad steel sword crossed over a shield (dark knight), 3) a golden longbow with a nocked glowing arrow and leaves (fairy elf), 4) a sword and a magic flame crossed (magic gladiator).

icons_classes_2.prompt: A row of exactly 4 separate square character CLASS EMBLEM icons, evenly spaced in a single horizontal row with clear empty gaps between them, each icon same size inside its own round bronze-gold medallion frame with dark interior: 1) a golden royal scepter with a crown (dark lord), 2) an open glowing purple grimoire book with a summoning circle (summoner), 3) a clenched armored gauntlet fist with fiery energy (rage fighter), 4) a bright golden plus sign / cross made of metal with a soft glow (create new character).

icons_roster.prompt: A row of exactly 2 separate square game menu ICONS, evenly spaced in a single horizontal row with a wide empty gap between them, each icon same size inside its own round bronze-gold medallion frame with dark interior: 1) a cracked skull with a small red flame (delete character), 2) a curved golden arrow pointing back to the left (return / back).
